extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded final mechanism adjudication from primary figure captions/images, results text, and Table 4; no unsupported direct target is added.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM source evidence supports visible cell wall/membrane disruption and intracellular-content leakage or cytoplasm loss in PRSP after DM1-DM5 treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: TEM morphology supports structural disruption but does not identify a single molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Plate-count time-kill data support rapid pneumocidal activity for DM1-DM5 at 2x MIC compared with penicillin, recorded as phenotype evidence rather than a molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Killing kinetics do not by themselves prove the cell-wall/membrane disruption mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Checkerboard FIC rows support in vitro synergy between each DM peptide and penicillin across pneumococcal susceptibility groups; this is an interaction phenotype, not proof of penicillin-target modulation by the peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The primary table reports FIC index/interpretation but not a direct molecular target for synergy.
